purpose: Prove FUSE Google Intelligence Runtime V2 through the existing private gateway without creating or routing traffic to the canonical production service during a cold start. If the canonical gateway service exists, use a tagged zero-traffic revision. If it does not exist, create a uniquely named IAM-protected ephemeral canary service under superior-logic-runtime, prove V1 generateContent and V2 Gemini 3.8 Interactions exact nonces, then delete the ephemeral service and verify absence. Preserve shared-WIF hardening debt separately.
truth_boundary: G3 success requires bounded deployment transport, independently verified runtime ADC/model authority, exact semantic receipts, zero canonical production traffic, and verified cleanup of any ephemeral cold-start service. Ephemeral canary traffic is not production traffic and must be deleted before success. No production service creation, production traffic promotion, public unauthenticated access, new IAM role, service-account key, case data, external communication or proof inheritance is authorized.
